scope: frequency–wavevector matching for magnetic spin-wave space-time wave packets; direct free propagation versus driven radiation explicitly distinguished
evidence_note: Scientific assessments are based on the source depth and locators stated per record. No universal no-prior-work claim is made.

records.title: Spin-Cherenkov effect and magnonic Mach cones
records.authors: Yan, Ming; Kákay, Attila; Andreas, Christian; Hertel, Riccardo
records.assessment_note: Moving localized magnetic source imposes omega=vk; the stable profile is maintained in excitation–dissipation equilibrium. No source-off free-packet demonstration established by these pages.

records.title: Magnon-Cherenkov effect from a picosecond strain pulse
records.locator: Research Square v1 (2025-03-25), PDF pp. 3–4; Eqs. (1)–(2); published 2026-01-23
records.assessment_note: Moving strain-induced torque selects phase-velocity-matched exchange spin waves; not a demonstrated source-off two-dimensional ST wave-packet construction.

records.title: Non-Dispersive Space-Time Wave Packets Propagating in Dispersive Media
records.authors: He, Hao; Guo, Cheng; Xiao, Meng
records.locator: arXiv:2109.00782v1, PDF pp. 1–2, Eqs. (1)–(5); high-order section pp. 4–5
records.assessment_note: Spectral constraint selects the dispersion-surface intersection and yields rigid propagation; finite spectral precision and higher-order terms already discussed.

records.title: Space-time wave packets
records.authors: Yessenov, Murat; Hall, Layton A.; Schepler, Kenneth L.; Abouraddy, Ayman F.
records.assessment_note: Exact delta spectral correlation, infinite-energy ideal fields, finite spectral uncertainty and limited propagation distance are established optical results.

records.title: Space–Time Surface Plasmon Polaritons: A New Propagation-Invariant Surface Wave Packet
records.authors: Schepler, Kenneth L.; Yessenov, Murat; Zhiyenbayev, Yertay; Abouraddy, Ayman F.
records.locator: arXiv:2003.02105v2; Sec. III, Eq. (10); Sec. III.E, PDF pp. 7–8; Sec. IV.D, pp. 10–11
records.assessment_note: Ideal ST surface waves, finite correlation uncertainty and dissipative propagation have already been treated for SPPs.

records.title: Observation of space-time surface plasmon polaritons
records.authors: Ichiji, Naoki; Kikuchi, Hibiki; Yessenov, Murat; Schepler, Kenneth L.; Abouraddy, Ayman F.; Kubo, Atsushi
records.locator: published PDF p. 4, practical NA compromise; Results and Discussion, pp. 6–8
records.assessment_note: Experiment uses nonseparable ST spectra and verifies diffraction-free propagation; finite NA forces a curved axial spectral projection, so GVD is reduced rather than eliminated completely.

records.title: Space-time electron wave packets with tunable skyrmion textures
records.locator: arXiv:2610.08391v1, PDF pp. 1–3, Fig. 1; journal publication 2026-10-07
records.assessment_note: Spectral-plane construction on a quadratic free-electron dispersion already exists; electron spin textures are not magnetic collective spin waves.

records.title: Dispersionless propagation of ultra-short spin-wave pulses in ultrathin yttrium iron garnet waveguides
records.assessment_note: Dipolar/exchange competition yields a low-dispersion guided-pulse window; not a demonstrated freely propagating two-dimensional correlated-spectrum ST packet.

records.title: Spin-Wave Optical Elements: Towards Spin-Wave Fourier Optics
records.authors: Vogel, M.; Hillebrands, B.; von Freymann, G.
records.assessment_note: Axicon-generated Bessel-like monochromatic beams and self-healing are not a demonstration of simultaneous temporal and transverse localization preservation.

records.title: All-Angle Collimation for Spin Waves
records.authors: Kłos, J. W.; Gruszecki, P.; Serebryannikov, A. E.; Krawczyk, M.
records.locator: arXiv:1703.05548v1, PDF pp. 1–2; abstract explicitly monochromatic beams
records.assessment_note: Isofrequency geometry and refraction collimate monochromatic spin waves; not a broadband ST-packet preservation demonstration.

records.title: Generation of Spin-Wave Pulses by Inverse Design
records.locator: arXiv:2209.06608v1, PDF pp. 1–3 and 6; Eq. (1), Figs. 1–2, Conclusion
records.assessment_note: Single-band waveguide inverse driving produces prescribed shapes at a selected time; does not establish unchanged free propagation of the full two-dimensional packet.

records.title: Experimental Realization of a Passive Gigahertz Frequency-Division Demultiplexer for Magnonic Logic Networks
records.locator: published PDF pp. 1–4; experimental frequency-dependent beam routing and conclusion
records.assessment_note: Frequency-dependent beam direction is established experimentally; routing separate channels does not impose the required joint axial phase condition.

records.title: Space-time duality in magnonics: Temporal diffraction in magnonic waveguides
records.locator: publisher abstract, Highlights and Introduction; full text not obtained
records.assessment_note: Public content describes temporal diffraction, compression and temporal lenses; exact degree of overlap requires full text.

records.title: Spatiotemporal diffractive magnonics in two-dimensional magnetic systems
records.locator: Phys. Rev. B 113, 054423, 2026-02-12; publisher abstract; references metadata
records.assessment_note: Initial spatial encoding of magnetization evolution and pattern reemergence are explicit. Cannot exclude an equivalent spectral-matching construction without full text.

records.title: Discrete diffraction and shape-invariant beams in optical waveguide arrays
records.assessment_note: General moment evolution is prior art; functional-shape preservation with varying beam parameters is not the same as fixed-shape rigid translation.

records.title: Shaping nonreciprocal caustic spin-wave beams
records.locator: arXiv:2404.15011v4, PDF pp. 1–3, near-field response and experimental beam mapping
records.assessment_note: A practical anisotropic spin-wave source/response baseline; beam steering is not equivalent to full ST-packet invariance.

records.title: Spatiotemporal diffraction-free pulsed beams in free-space of the Airy and Bessel type
records.locator: arXiv:1711.04027v1, PDF pp. 1–2, Fig. 1 and spectral constraint
records.assessment_note: Conic-section spectral constructions and named waveform families are already established optical methods.
